subject: Urgent: Velosync latency & error spike after v3.1-quant rollout
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@velosync.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@velosync.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: High latency & 5xx increase after model upgrade

Grace —

We just finished the canary of v3.1 with the new quantization profile (q8-mixed) earlier this morning and are seeing a sharp regression in production traffic. Key signals over the last 45m:
- p50 ~ 460ms -> 520ms (small)
- p95 ~ 450ms -> 1.82s (huge)
- throughput dropped ~18% despite similar QPS
- 5xx rate increased from ~0.2% to 6.9% (mostly 524/timeouts + occasional 502)

This is affecting search/autocomplete for our mobile flows — conversion impact already visible. Can you please escalate? We need either an immediate fallback or a clear mitigation plan. Attaching a metric snapshot and some request samples.

We have a short maintenance window starting in ~30 minutes if that helps.

— Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Platform, Velosync
amit@velosync.com

Attachments: metrics_snapshot_20260622.png, request_samples_0900-1000.json

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@velosync.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@velosync.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & 5xx increase after model upgrade

Amit — thanks for the quick heads-up and the attachments. I'm escalating to infra immediately (cc'd).

Immediate ask: can you confirm the exact model alias you pushed (full name & variant) and whether any routing policy changed? Also confirm whether you limited concurrency client-side during the canary.

Preliminary plan (we can move faster if you want rollback now):
1) Engineering triage (Jonas/Ben) to look at kernel-level stalls and quant decode paths.
2) If triage indicates quantized stack is the source, we propose a fast rollback to v3.0-unquant (or v3.1 with fp32) for the canary and then a staged rerun.
3) We'll run smoke checks on p95/p99 and error surface for 15m post-rollback.

We can perform the rollback during your window in 30 minutes if you give the go-ahead. If you'd prefer we start immediately, say the word.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0127

Attachments: support_logs_22jun.zip

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit@velosync.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & 5xx increase after model upgrade

On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 9:14 AM Amit Shah <amit@velosync.com> wrote:
> We just finished the canary of v3.1 with the new quantization profile (q8-mixed) earlier this morning and are seeing a sharp regression in production traffic....

Thanks for the details and samples, Amit. I've pulled the logs in the support bundle — initial impressions:
- Several workers hit decode stalls when loading q8 attention kernels for certain long-token prefixes (likely input length distribution mismatch).
- KV cache growth patterns in these requests differ from training distribution causing memory pressure and retry timeouts (524).
- No obvious network degradation; this looks compute/codec related.

Immediate mitigations we can execute now:
- Option A (fastest): Route the canary traffic back to v3.0-fp32 (no quant) — low risk, expected to restore p95 within 5–10 minutes.
- Option B: Keep v3.1 but disable q8 attention kernel (falls back to safer kernel) — medium risk; might have some throughput hit but could reduce errors.

I'll coordinate with Ben to run Option A during the 30m window unless you instruct otherwise. Post-rollback we'll run the smoke checks and push a readout to the shared runbook: https://redwood.app/runbooks/velosync-rollback-2026-06-22

Jonas Weber
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

Runbook excerpt (internal): Rollback model alias -> wait for steady-state 15m -> validate p95/p99 & 5xx -> capture heap profiles if regressions persist.

From: Amit Shah <amit@velosync.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & 5xx increase after model upgrade

Grace / Jonas —

Thanks. Confirming the model alias: velosync-search-v3.1:q8-mixed. No routing policy changes on our side; this was a straight canary (5% of traffic) from our CI pipeline. We are okay with Option A and authorize the rollback to v3.0-fp32 during the maintenance window starting at 10:00 PDT.

Please start as soon as you're ready and ping us with the verification checklist. We'll hold off further pushes until you confirm stability.

— Amit

P.S. Elena and I can be on a quick Zoom while you perform the change if that helps.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@velosync.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@velosync.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & 5xx increase after model upgrade

Amit / Elena — scheduling rollback now for 10:00 PDT. Quick run-through of the plan:
- 09:59: stop canary routing to v3.1:q8-mixed and shift to v3.0-fp32 for the 5% canary.
- 10:00–10:15: monitor p95/p99, throughput, error rates.
- Owner: Jonas (executes rollback), Ben (observability + alerts), Grace (customer comms).
- Success criteria: p95 <= 700ms and 5xx <= 0.5% within 15 minutes.
- Escalation: if not met by 10:30 PDT, we will: 1) open an executive bridge, 2) enable regional fallback routing, 3) put the incident to P1 with exec notification.

I'll post the smoke check results and the runbook link to the HubSpot deal record after the window. Please keep the Zoom on if you can — Jonas will message when the change is complete.

Thanks — we'll aim to have this stabilized quickly.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
